alert: Everything that touches the database got slow at once, and now the app keeps reporting that the database refuses new connections.

source.title: Honeycomb, RDS performance degradation postmortem (2018-05-03)
source.notes: Original: the RDS MySQL instance degraded suddenly (P95 query time 11 ms to over 1000 ms) and load passed max_connections (Error 1040); the cause of the instance degradation is outside what a lab can reproduce. Lab: the MySQL container's CPU limit is cut to 0.05 so every statement is slow, and clients open new connections to compensate until error 1040. Expected answer: the hardware cause is outside the closed set of root causes; the one anomaly in the set that the evidence shows is exhausted connections held by ordinary, indexed statements, with no lock and no missing index. So connection_exhaustion is the hit and undetermined is acceptable; naming a missing index or a lock wait is a miss (the same rule as holdout H1).
